summary.text: Laurie Ryan is the Republican, Conservative and Vote Affordable Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 95 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ryan's campaign website lists seven bills she says she would introduce, beginning with one to prohibit extra fees or charges for state projects from being added to utility bills.
Her second listed bill would equalize individual state income tax brackets, and the third would re-formulate property taxes and rename them service taxes.
